claims.text: The current BPAS public home identifies itself as Greater Bengaluru Authority and describes a single-window construction-permit system for Bengaluru.
The BPAS public home exposes a Sign In form with username, password, CAPTCHA-code input and a login submit control; this pass stops before authentication and case data.
The BPAS public home displays an important message that e-Khata is mandatory for Building Licence, Plinth Certificate and Occupancy Certificate applications from 1 July 2025.

The BPAS public Download & Manuals route lists a User Manual for OC and public forms/checklists including a plan-sanction checklist, affidavits, bonds, Schedule-II and Schedule-III; it notes that affidavits and bonds should be on stamp paper.

The official BPAS FAQ says an Occupancy Certificate/Building Completion Certificate application is submitted online by a Licensed Surveyor or Architect after building completion, with a request for joint site inspection and compliance of OCC/BCC conditions.
The official BPAS FAQ states that Part/Full OCC/BCC is granted within 7 working days after the OC/BCC application when the required documents are submitted and the work is executed as approved.

The official BPAS FAQ describes authenticated dashboard steps for viewing OCC/BCC status and certificate output through the approved OCC/BCC entry, Application Summary and Proposal Stages certificate column.
BPAS exposes a public Helpdesk Knowledge base and a public Contact Us route as support surfaces; no case-specific recovery result was tested.

The supplied site.bbmp.gov.in/buildingplan.html route was not live at access time and returned a browser ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED observation; its older indexed content is not current workflow evidence.
The current bbmp.gov.in/home page exposes a Building Permission e-Service tile, but the public DOM observation did not expose a target URL; no link to BPAS is asserted.
